title: I Only Know Your Eyes
subject: Two day-shift packers on a biscuit factory's custard-cream line fall in love knowing only each other's eyes between hairnet and blue beard snood, and outside the gate she walks straight past him until he cups his hands over his beard.
caption: Uplifting vocal trance, 2020s anthemic trance with a long breakdown and snare-roll build. Detuned supersaw lead in wide sidechained chord stabs, rolling offbeat sub-bass, gated pluck arpeggio in sixteenth notes, four-on-the-floor 909 kick with offbeat open hi-hats, bright piano chords in the breakdown. Wide club mix, clean polished master. Female soprano, strong bright full-voice topline with long open notes on the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 138 BPM, A minor. Euphoric, yearning, bright. No rap, no autotune effect, no trap hi-hats, no distorted guitars, no whispered vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro - pluck arpeggio, soft kick, filtered supersaw]

[Verse 1]
Six a.m. on the custard-cream line
Hairnet, blue snood, gloves on tight
All I know of you is your eyes
Over the biscuits going by

[Pre-Chorus]
Every shift you pass me the tray
Every shift I forget what to say

[Chorus]
I only know your eyes, your eyes
Over the belt in the factory light
I only know your eyes, your eyes
Tell me it's you, tell me it's right

[Verse 2]
Out at the gate I walked on by
A stranger's chin, a stranger's smile
Then you cupped your hands over your beard
And there were the eyes, so near

[Pre-Chorus]
Every shift you pass me the tray
Now I know just what to say

[Chorus]
I know your face now, I know your eyes
Out in the open, out in the light
I know your face now, I know your eyes
Take off the snood, you're mine tonight

[Outro - arpeggio alone, kick drops out]
I only know your eyes
